brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued their incursion into Qalqilya city on Wednesday, the Ma'an news agency reported, maintaining a siege on multiple entry points to the Palestinian municipality.

The operation involved restricting movement in and out of the city as military units remained deployed throughout Qalqilya's streets. No immediate details were available on the scale of the forces involved or the stated purpose of the ongoing operation.
title: Israeli forces continue storming Qalqilya, sealing city entrances
